evidence_quotes.name_asked: Roselyn Pammit: Hi Vic, good morning. This is from moving.
evidence_quotes.name_used_again: Not used again after initial greeting.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No quid pro quo framing present. Rep goes straight into explaining the virtual walkthrough without a time-boxed commitment or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. No version of the two-concerns opener (movers showing up on time / damage to items) appears in the transcript.
evidence_quotes.step4_probing: Rep asks about square footage, downsizing vs. additional stops, items being moved, and truck capacity. However, no concern-led opening (What items are you most concerned about?). Packing and box count are never asked.
evidence_quotes.promises: Neither On-Time Guarantee nor No Worries Damage Coverage are mentioned anywhere in the call.

top_strength: The rep stayed calm and patient through a complex technical discussion about square footage, truck capacity, and move scope, accurately explaining why a virtual walkthrough or photo/video submission would help provide an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: On walkthrough-routing calls, lead with the customer's name and a clear quid pro quo before jumping into logistics — and deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before proposing the walkthrough, so the customer knows what Einstein stands for regardless of which path you take next.
